name: 04_reply_tone
task: Reply to an inbound message in the owner's voice
provenance_detail: TARGET verbatim his, from the corpus he supplied and whose removals he approved 2026-08-26. INBOUND side is RECONSTRUCTED by this lane — the original inbound messages were never supplied, so they are inferred from what each reply plainly answers, and written as a correspondent would write them rather than as a summary of the reply (an inbound restating the reply teaches echoing). 20 pairs: smaller than the design's 60-200, stated rather than padded.
owner_decision: 2026-08-26 — 'yes we can use my writing', then 'I approve the removals'
